'''Version 1.5.2''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 22th 2020.  It was 3.35 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>Fixes</u> ====

* Fixed a typo in the name of one item 
* Fixed loot tables for Adapted versions of [[Adapted Summoner|Canra]] and [[Adapted Reeker|Nogla]] not working
* Fixed the [[Stage I Beckon|Venkrol Stage I]] bell sound sometimes playing and not spawning the mob itself

==== <u>Changes</u> ====

* Added an option of flight height limit to air type mobs
* Added an option to disable bell sounds from the [[Reinforcement System]]
* Added [[Infected Flesh]] to [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|infected versions]] loot tables by default
